description: Canonical sector registry per Directive §12. 10 target sectors with evidence classification per §23.

sectors.title: Financial Services
sectors.description: Risk classification, audit trails, and regulatory reporting for banks, microfinance, SACCOs, and mobile-money institutions across Malawi and African markets.
keyUseCases: Continuous compliance monitoring and regulatory reporting
Automated risk analysis and credit scoring
Audit trail generation with SHA-256 sealing
Central bank reporting automation
Mobile-money reconciliation and reporting
sectors.honestyNote: Governed multi-agent compliance automation for a regional financial institution: regulatory reporting across 14 departments with full audit trails, cutting reporting time by 40%.

sectors.title: Healthcare & Public Health

Donor-ready M&E reports from Kobo and DHIS2 data
Interactive program dashboards (mobile-friendly, NGO-grade)
Citizen-query agents for public health information
Billing compliance and patient scheduling automation

sectors.title: Agriculture & Agritech

Chichewa-language farmer advisory agents

sectors.title: Education & Academia

University AI capacity building programs

sectors.title: Government & Public Sector
